purpose: High-volume investing publication architecture for producing, organizing, discovering, and maintaining ten pieces of content per day.
everydayOperations: Publish 10 fresh news or resource updates with headline, summary, source link, why it matters, and investor takeaway
Update the Daily Briefing so today's headlines are visible on homepage, News, Market Pulse, search, archives, and newsletter paths
Check trusted source links including BLS, BEA, Federal Reserve, Treasury, SEC EDGAR, FRED, company filings, ETF issuers, and Investor.gov
Add or improve one evergreen guide, glossary entry, academy lesson, checklist, calculator note, or portfolio resource
Refresh Market Pulse with valuation, rates, breadth, earnings, risk, liquidity, and action context
Add related content links from every new item to hubs, tools, glossary terms, reports, archives, and learning paths
Prepare daily brief, weekly recap, or newsletter asset from the strongest updates
Run quality checks for links, buttons, mobile layout, empty cards, accessibility, source visibility, and section usefulness
Track planned, drafted, reviewed, published, updated, archived, and refreshed items
preservationPolicy: Do not remove old articles, reports, pages, tools, guides, newsletters, or archives during daily publishing
Keep historical content discoverable through archives, search, categories, topics, related content, author pages, and internal links
Refresh older content with update notes, source links, context, and related resources instead of hiding it
Preserve dated market notes as historical records while clearly showing newer updates above them
